verdict.rationale: Netlify ships in-dashboard AI agents, so letting users plug MCP servers into them is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows the product consuming external MCP servers. The one AI-connection item describes connecting outside AI assistants to Netlify, which is the opposite (server-side) direction and does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
